As Apple (AAPL) Shares Declined, Bremer Trust National Association Has Trimmed Stake by $439,569; Puplava Financial Services Has Upped Stake in Regions Finl New (RF)
May 24, 2018 - By Jonathan Benavides
Puplava Financial Services Inc increased its stake in Regions Finl Corp New (RF) by 75.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Puplava Financial Services Inc bought 83,155 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.69% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 192,613 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.33M, up from 109,458 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Puplava Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Regions Finl Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.36B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.96% or $0.19 during the last trading session, reaching $19.01. About 1.46M shares traded. Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF) has risen 29.90% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.35% the S&P500.
Bremer Trust National Association decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bremer Trust National Association sold 2,601 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 41,796 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.07M, down from 44,397 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bremer Trust National Association who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.11B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.62% or $1.16 during the last trading session, reaching $187.2. About 3.55 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
